project_title: Does Compression Forget Language? Language-Specific Feature Survival Under Quantization and Pruning in Multilingual LLMs

hardware_and_environment.quantized_modules: Attention (q, k, v, o_proj) and MLP (gate, up, down_proj) - 182 Linear modules total

dataset_metadata.resource_tiers: 9 High, 9 Mid, 9 Low (Joshi et al., 2020 taxonomy)
dataset_metadata.script_families: Latin, Devanagari, Dravidian, Cyrillic, CJK, Hangul, Ethiopic, Khmer, Lao
dataset_metadata.control_mechanism: Exact token-budget equalization across languages to eliminate subword fertility bias

w0_sanity_check.verdict: PASS: nonzero language-selective feature population found at layer 12

multilang_sanity_check.verdict: PASS: every language pair shows a nonzero selective-feature population

phase1_survival_quintile_matching.device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

family.statement: Language-selective features survive INT7 RTN quantization at a significantly different rate than quintile-matched universal features.
Language-selective features survive INT6 RTN quantization at a significantly different rate than quintile-matched universal features.

family.test: One-sided permutation test across the 27-language panel, controlling for script family
